prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 32 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1117; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck and low back pain, consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion, which correlate with a soft tissue strain pattern. Neurological screening and several orthopedic provocation tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this office. Care consisted of 32 visits over the course of the treatment period, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The frequency of visits was reduced gradually as symptoms resolved and functional mobility improved, and the patient was discharged to an independent home program. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated charges.
